title: 第51章 兄弟相聚
content_zh:
第51章 兄弟相聚-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

电话那头沉默了两秒，随即传来一道咋咋呼呼声音：

“四蛋子，你丫的又扯什么犊子，搁你爸爸这儿寻开心呢是吧？”

“谁跟你扯犊子？老子说的是真的，真在云市，骗你是孙子！”

二愣子朱子明还是半信半疑，最后得知吴姜真的来了，才惊喜的问道：“蛋子，你真来了？你现在在哪儿，我马上去接你！”

“不用你接，发个位置过来，老子开车找你，让你见识见识你姜哥的排场。”

朱子明豪不在乎他嘚瑟的语气，也不跟他客气，位置直接发到了吴姜的手机上。

挂了电话，吴姜立马发动车子，朝着朱子明发的位置方向驶去。

朱子明现在是一家保险公司的销售员，不算什么好工作，但胜在离家近，现在工作不好找，只能先过渡一下。

朱子明家也算是小康家庭，上面有四个姐姐，他是家里的老幺，从小被宠着长大。

只是父母年纪大了，身体也不算太好，他就不想在外面打工了，家里虽然挣得钱少，但开销也小，还能随时照顾父母，一举两得。

半个多小时后，吴姜开车来到了朱子明发的位置，远远就看到他正站在路边东张西望。

吴姜缓缓将车停在他面前，按了一下喇叭。

朱子明转过头，看到停在自己面前的越野车，随即又看到了坐在车里的吴姜。

朱子明没有急着上车，先是围着车子转了两圈，又伸手拍了拍引擎盖子，发出“砰砰”的闷响，这才凑到车窗边，用一副不敢置信的语气问道：

“我靠！老四！这……这是你的车？”

吴姜摇下车窗，一脸嘚瑟地靠在座椅上，扬了扬下巴：“那可不，怎么样？够气派吧？”

“气派！太气派了！”朱子明连连点头，一把拉开车门，将吴姜拽了下去，一屁股坐在了驾驶位上。

男人嘛，哪有不爱开车的，除非你天天开，已经快要开吐了。

朱子明抚摸着方向盘，又摸了摸前面的大屏，眼神里的羡慕都快溢出来了。

“你小子可以啊，这是中彩票了还是捡钱了？”

吴姜见他不想下来了，只好无语的坐进了副驾驶，心想，怎么和李月芽那个死丫头一个德行。

“家里老爹给买的毕业礼物，你什么时候见老子买彩票中过奖？”

说起这个，吴姜就一肚子气。

有一年，哥几个迷上了刮刮乐，那一个月的时间，另外三个畜生虽然大奖没中过，但是小奖多多少少还是开出几张的。

只有吴姜，花了几百块钱，愣是毛都没有刮出一根来。

只是，他也没有和朱子明说实话，将一切都推到了自己老子身上。

这话一出，朱子明是更羡慕了，也更酸了，正应了那句，既怕兄弟过得苦，又怕兄弟开路虎。

There was silence on the other end of the phone for two seconds, and then a whirring voice came:

"Sidanzi, what the hell are you talking about? Are you just leaving your father here to have fun?"

"Who is kidding you? What I said is true. I am really in Yun City. I lied to you that I am my grandson!"

The idiot Zhu Ziming was still dubious. When he finally learned that Wu Jiang was really here, he asked in surprise: "Danzi, are you really here? Where are you now? I'll pick you up right away!"

"You don't need to pick up the car. Send me a seat. I'll drive to you and show you what your brother Jiang is like."

Zhu Ziminghao didn't care about his sarcastic tone and was not polite to him. He sent the location directly to Wu Jiang's mobile phone.

After hanging up the phone, Wu Jiang immediately started the car and drove in the direction of Zhu Ziming's location.

Zhu Ziming is now a salesperson in an insurance company. It is not a good job, but it is close to home. It is difficult to find a job now, so he can only make a transition first.

Zhu Ziming's family can be considered a well-off family, with four sisters. He is the youngest in the family and has been pampered since he was a child.

It's just that his parents are old and not in good health, so he doesn't want to work outside. Although the family earns less money, the expenses are also small, and he can take care of his parents at any time, killing two birds with one stone.

More than half an hour later, Wu Jiang drove to the location where Zhu Ziming died, and saw him standing on the roadside looking around from a distance.

Wu Jiang slowly parked the car in front of him and honked the horn.

Zhu Ziming turned his head and saw the off-road vehicle parked in front of him, and then saw Wu Jiang sitting in the car.

Zhu Ziming was not in a hurry to get in the car. He circled around the car twice first, then reached out and patted the engine cover, making a dull sound. Then he came to the window and asked in an unbelievable tone:

"Holy crap! Fourth child! This...is this your car?"

Wu Jiang rolled down the window, leaned on the seat with a sullen expression, and raised his chin: "That's not it, how about it? Is it impressive enough?"

"Magnificent! So impressive!" Zhu Ziming nodded repeatedly, pulled open the car door, pulled Wu Jiang out, and sat down on the driver's seat.

Men, there’s no one who doesn’t love driving, unless you drive every day and you’re about to vomit.

Zhu Ziming touched the steering wheel and then touched the large screen in front, the envy in his eyes almost overflowing.

"You can do it, kid. Did you win the lottery or pick up money?"

Seeing that he didn't want to get off, Wu Jiang had no choice but to sit in the passenger seat speechlessly, wondering how he could be as virtuous as that dead girl Li Yueya.

"My father bought me a graduation gift at home. When did you ever see me win a lottery ticket?"

Speaking of this, Wu Jiang became angry.

One year, my brothers were obsessed with scratch tickets. During that month, although the other three beasts didn't win the big prize, they still got a few small prizes.

Only Wu Jiang spent hundreds of dollars and didn't even get a hair out of it.

However, he did not tell the truth to Zhu Ziming and blamed everything on his father.

As soon as these words came out, Zhu Ziming became even more envious and bitter. Just as he said, he was not only afraid that his brother would have a hard time, but also afraid that his brother would drive a Land Rover.
